entries.description: Reviewed the accepted distributor baseline, the binding multi-organization planning inputs, and the remaining unstarted Phase 2 session-set specs through a routed analysis pass to freeze the organization-aware defaults before implementation begins.

Created docs/planning/multi-org-security-decision-ledger.md to freeze the configurable internal default-organization behavior, active-organization timing, initial organization-scoped versus global entity split, and the no-downstream-rebaseline verdict for Session 1.

Created docs/planning/multi-org-security-architecture-baseline.md to capture the accepted organization-aware data model, runtime permission, API-context, seeding, and implementation guardrails that later sessions will implement.

Updated docs/session-sets/multi-org-security/spec.md to record that no cross-set overlap is safe yet and that only a narrow Session 3 versus Session 4 UI overlap becomes acceptable after Session 2 freezes the membership contract.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build. Build succeeded with the existing 11 DevEmailInbox XML-comment warnings plus preview-SDK notices, and all 383 tests passed including AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web, Playwright, and reusable-library coverage.
Ran mandatory external session verification for Session 1 using the Session 1 spec excerpt, the planning and spec artifacts, the current activity log, and successful build/test evidence.
